verdict.rationale: Supabase's first-party docs say Storage can "optimize and resize images on the fly" for any image in a bucket. Transform options work on signed and public URLs and are supported in the client libraries, so developers can serve transformed images without running their own pipeline. The feature is gated to Pro Plan and above. Missing for 10: availability on lower-tier plans, independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed documentation of the transform options in the evidence (formats, quality, crop modes).
